_meta.description: The Rooftop Bar - Yelp with accurate current open/closed status

yelp_rooftop_bar.name: The Rooftop Bar
yelp_rooftop_bar.address: 620 Jones St, Rooftop Level, San Francisco, CA 94102

rev_yrtb_001.text: Went last Saturday night and the views were spectacular. The craft cocktail menu has new spring additions. The grapefruit rosemary gin fizz is divine.

rev_yrtb_002.text: Great rooftop spot. Note they are CLOSED on Sundays. The happy hour from 5-7 PM has great deals. Views of the city lights are amazing at night.

rev_yrtb_003.text: Perfect spot for drinks with friends. The small plates are tasty. Gets busy after 9 PM on Fridays and Saturdays. Smart casual dress code enforced.
